properties.level_of_theory: Gaussian16 PM7 (RPM7), gas phase, charge 0, singlet
properties.note: Isolated (Z)-hex-3-ene-1,5-diyne minimum; unimolecular reaction, so this minimum is the pre-reaction (reactant) state. Lowest-energy verified minimum (0 imaginary frequencies, 24 real modes, lowest 107.8 cm-1). A second starting conformer (rc2/conf2_opt.log, rotated 180 deg about C2-C3) relaxed back to the same minimum.
Single imaginary mode -427.92 cm-1 dominated by C1...C6 closing (each 0.349 of the squared displacement). TS geometry: C1-C6 1.578, C1-C2 = C5-C6 1.297, C2-C3 = C4-C5 1.357, C3-C4 1.429 A.

p-benzyne (1,4-didehydrobenzene) minimum, 0 imaginary frequencies (24 real modes, lowest 346.6 cm-1). Radical centres at the two didehydro carbons (map atoms 2 and 5 in the reactant numbering; ring positions 1 and 4 of the product). PM7 is a closed-shell semiempirical description, so the biradical is represented by one closed-shell determinant.
